items.title: AIHOT
items.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。
items.summary: AIHOT is a framework for creating your own industry news site, which collects items from various sources like RSS, web pages, JSON feeds, X, and WeChat. It filters and scores them twice with an LLM, clusters reports into events, and publishes daily briefings. Users can replace sources, selection criteria, and prompts to tailor the framework to their specific industry needs. The framework includes a daily report feature that compiles selected content into a structured report without needing a large model for generation. The sources do not provide specific details about the exact number of sources or their types, but they emphasize the flexibility and customization options available for users to adapt the framework to their own needs.

items.title: dots
items.description: Open-source dots for the web: an AI agent with its own browser, one that does not get blocked.
items.summary: According to the sources, dots are always-on agents that live in ChatGPT, each with its own cloud computer and browser. They can keep working on tasks between conversations, access over 4,000 connected apps, and maintain their own notes about preferences and ongoing work. When a website requires a login, dots send a private form for credentials and verification codes, ensuring the model never sees them. The computer keeps its state between uses, with its own files, software, and browser sessions. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on today's date or specific details about the launch date of dots.

items.title: jevgrep
items.description: Find code by asking what it does. A CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context.
items.summary: JevGrep is a command-line tool for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context by asking what the code does in plain English. It returns relevant files, reading leads, and selected source excerpts with line references. It is not a coding agent itself but a retrieval CLI that provides context for a separate coding agent or developer to make and verify changes. It requires Node.js 22+ and a Vercel AI Gateway key configured with `jg auth`. The tool is available via npm install-g at ddeng/jvgp and is compatible with Codex and Claude Code.

The skill provides structured exploration with 55 visual styles, 30 color palettes, and AI generation prompts, and it can generate professional SVG logos and high-end showcase images. It supports various design tasks such as logo generation, corporate identity programs, banner design, and icon creation. The skill is activated implicitly when users request logo or icon design and explicitly via specific prompts.

items.title: onetake
items.description: Motion films that never cut to the next slide: every beat grows out of the one before, one continuous camera, continuity measured by an oracle. A Claude Agent Skill for product launch films and feature demos.
items.summary: onetake is a Claude Agent Skill that produces 15- to 30-second launch films, teasers, and feature demos using a continuous virtual camera with no cuts between scenes. It uses an oracle script to score transition continuity per boundary, and films below a certain threshold are rejected before human review. The films feature visible elements from one product beat carried into the next, with the virtual camera following transformations without cutting, anticipating where elements will land, and panning or whipping toward them.

items.title: SolidWorks
items.description: SolidWorks MCP Server connects an AI assistant to a running SolidWorks instance. Sketch, extrude, fillet, export STEP/STL, generate macros.
items.summary: The SolidWorks MCP Server allows AI assistants like Claude to control SolidWorks by creating parts, sketching, extruding, assembling, running FEA simulations, and exporting files in various formats such as STEP, IGES, STL, and PDF through natural language. It supports both 3DEXPERIENCE Works (cloud) and SolidWorks Desktop COM API (Windows). The server integrates with SolidWorks API and structures it into Claude-compatible context streams, raising the level of abstraction to manage the economic problem of context size and token cost. It requires Windows and SolidWorks 2026, .NET Framework 4.8, MSBuild, Python 3.x, and an MCP-capable AI client. The architecture involves an AI client communicating with the MCP server, which then translates into an API operation for SolidWorks. The sources do not provide specific pricing or a definitive release date for SolidWorks 2026.

items.description: A Markdown convention and linter for project docs written by AI and read by humans and agents
items.summary: Seiso is a Markdown convention and linter for project documentation written by AI and read by humans and agents. It aims to standardize how Markdown in a repository is organized, similar to how rustfmt settled formatting for Rust code. Projects share the rules instead of negotiating their own; each project mainly maps its documents to kinds, and `seiso init` suggests a starting point. The goal is to ensure that all code linters and formatters pass, and that conventions are followed in documentation for coding agents.

items.title: ten-levels-of-jev
items.description: Ten levels of Jev, from one smart if statement to a coding agent that reaches for Jev on its own
items.summary: The sources describe Jev as a decision-making AI model that reads text only and does not generate text. Jev is used in workflows to verify claims, check coding agent commands, and make decisions based on the state and questions provided. It is not trained to write text, code, or summaries. items.summary: mcp-audit is a free, open-source security scanner for Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configurations. items.title: awesome-qwen-image
items.description: Qwen-Image 2.1. Checkpoints, quants, prompt engines, LoRAs, and tooling
items.summary: Qwen-Image 2.1 is a text-to-image model with 7B parameters in the visual generation component and 32 single-stream DiT layers. It features mixed-granularity attention and native RGBA output. The model can accept up to 10 reference images for editing and supports prompt-guided transformations. It is available via ComfyUI Desktop, requiring a PC with an NVIDIA graphics card and at least 24 GB of video memory. The model is released by Qwen in September 2026 and is priced at 0.4CU per megapixel. It offers production-ready outputs with strong prompt control and clean compositions for user applications.

items.summary: The motion-video-skill is an open-source AI agent skill for coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT, created by bestagentkits. It produces beat-synced 1080p motion-graphic videos in HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP) with an AI voice-over, karaoke captions, sound effects (SFX), and generated music. The skill is MIT licensed and has 87 GitHub stars. It is used to create a 1920×1080 30 fps motion-graphic video where scene cuts land on the music's beats, reveals land on spoken words, and the audio is broadcast-clean. The skill is demonstrated in a YouTube video by Moe Lueker, who also recommends using Hyperframes for video editing and Hen for adding a voice-over or video avatar.
